documentation.content: A backend request or earningsnerd-pregenerate job logged a terminal summary error, structured extraction failure, timeout, or failed refresh-stale regeneration. Inspect the filing-scoped log and related request/job execution. A pre-generation job can consume a terminal error event, so the failed-execution metric alone is insufficient. This catches logged failures; see the operations alert source map for silent terminal paths and docs/OPERATIONS.md.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: ((resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="earningsnerd-backend") OR (resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="earningsnerd-pregenerate")) AND ((jsonPayload.message:"Error in streaming summary" OR textPayload:"Error in streaming summary") OR (jsonPayload.message:"Pipeline timeout after" OR textPayload:"Pipeline timeout after") OR (jsonPayload.message:"Structured extraction error" OR textPayload:"Structured extraction error") OR (jsonPayload.message:"drain terminal=error" OR textPayload:"drain terminal=error") OR (jsonPayload.message:"Filing not found during stream generation" OR textPayload:"Filing not found during stream generation") OR (jsonPayload.message:"Error fetching SEC document" OR textPayload:"Error fetching SEC document") OR (jsonPayload.message:"refresh-stale: regeneration failed for filing" OR textPayload:"refresh-stale: regeneration failed for filing") OR (jsonPayload.message:"refresh-stale: generation ended in a terminal error for filing" OR textPayload:"refresh-stale: generation ended in a terminal error for filing"))
